scale: -2 cut/clear easing; -1 lean easier; 0 wait or no direction; +1 further 25 bp steps; +2 50 bp or faster
method: Staff scoring (d) of each speaker's latest policy remark in the window; equal weights; one score per speaker.

speakers.speaker: Christopher Waller
speakers.stance: Hike: a 50 bp increase in December is "probably necessary"; 25 bp only if the Fed clearly signals a January move. "You might need to, like, shock people."
speakers.quality: V (interview, quotes as reported by CNBC)

speakers.speaker: Alberto Musalem
speakers.stance: Hike: "several interest rate increases before the spring of 2027"; real policy rate should be "solidly between 2% and 2.5%".

speakers.speaker: Lorie Logan
speakers.stance: Hike: "at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases"; "may be possible to move more rapidly this winter".

speakers.speaker: Michael Barr
speakers.stance: Hike: "I expect it will be appropriate to raise rates further."

speakers.speaker: Beth Hammack
speakers.venue: Ohio State University event (reiterated 16 Nov in a TV interview)
speakers.stance: Hike, gradual: "more frequent, smaller rises"; larger steps only "if we get behind the curve, and I don't think we're behind the curve today".

speakers.speaker: John Williams
speakers.stance: Hike, gradual: likely to raise again, but no need for "dramatic action".

speakers.speaker: Austan Goolsbee
speakers.stance: Leaning hike: the Fed "has definitely got work to do"; no view on pace.
speakers.quality: V (interview, quotes as reported by CNBC)

speakers.speaker: Neel Kashkari
speakers.stance: Leaning hike: the Fed is "clearly missing on inflation side"; no step size.

speakers.speaker: Michelle Bowman
speakers.stance: Wait: further changes "should wait" for a better understanding; benefits of tightening "carefully weighed against its costs".

speakers.speaker: Philip Jefferson
speakers.stance: No direction: inflation "notably above" target; no rate guidance.

not_scored: Chair Warsh: 16 Nov opening remarks had no policy content.
Governor Cook: no policy remark found in the window (dissented for +25 bp on 28 Oct).
Other presidents: no remark found in the window search.
